_comment: Default voice config: the TYGER relay (docs/voice-tyger.md, Shape 2) — the holder runs backend=relay (caller frames over the bridge SSE, agent audio back via /live/audio), and the companion relay (scripts/tyger-live-relay.sh) bridges them to the tyger stack, which owns turn-taking (EARS), the reply and the speech (MOUTH). Tyger-side knobs are relay env vars (TYGER_URL, TYGER_EARS_CMD, TYGER_TTS_CMD, TYGER_VOICE, TYGER_SET, TYGER_TRAIT, TYGER_TAG_LAG_MS) — see integrations/eve-idfon-voice/tyger-relay.mjs. voice_route.mode=server-cascade tells callers the holder terminates audio over a live session. The streaming Deepgram/ElevenLabs cascade preset lives in providers/deepgram-elevenlabs.json (scripts/voice-serve.sh <file> to try it).
